why: No major reviewer or authority appears in the results. Only Volt & Valley answers the pellet-smoker question directly, and it uses assumed draw figures, not testing. The rest are about other appliances (an electric smoker, a pellet stove), single-brand pages (Grilla, Bluetti), an outdated listicle, a video summary, and unreadable pages. A focused page with measured pellet-smoker draw, overnight runtimes and current prices would stand out.
